reason: connection point at 110 kV or above (Art. 5(2)(d))

requirements.requirement: Frequency ranges and minimum time periods for operation
requirements.value: 47,5 Hz-48,5 Hz = To be specified by each TSO, but not less than 30 minutes; 48,5 Hz-49,0 Hz = To be specified by each TSO, but not less than the period for 47,5 Hz-48,5 Hz; 49,0 Hz-51,0 Hz = Unlimited; 51,0 Hz-51,5 Hz = 30 minutes
requirements.conditions: Continental Europe

requirements.requirement: Voltage ranges and minimum time periods for operation
requirements.value: 0,85 pu-0,90 pu = 60 minutes; 0,90 pu-1,118 pu = Unlimited; 1,118 pu-1,15 pu = To be specified by each TSO, but not less than 20 minutes and not more than 60 minutes
requirements.conditions: Continental Europe

requirements.requirement: Reactive power capability at maximum capacity
requirements.value: Maximum range of Q/Pmax: 0,75; Maximum range of steady-state voltage level in PU: 0,225
requirements.conditions: Continental Europe

requirements.requirement: Parameters of the voltage-against-time profile
requirements.value: Uret: 0; tclear: 0,14-0,15 (or 0,14-0,25 if system protection and secure operation so require); Uclear: Uret; trec1: tclear; Urec1: Uclear; trec2: trec1; Urec2: 0,85; trec3: 1,5-3,0
requirements.conditions: Connected at or above 110 kV. The TSO specifies the profile within these ranges.

requirements.requirement: A power-generating module shall be capable of staying connected to the network and operate at rates of change of frequency up to a value specified by the relevant TSO.
requirements.value: up to a value specified by the relevant TSO
requirements.conditions: unless disconnection was triggered by rate-of-change-of-frequency-type loss of mains protection

requirements.requirement: The power-generating module shall be capable of activating the provision of active power frequency response according to figure 1 at a frequency threshold and droop settings specified by the relevant TSO.
requirements.value: Frequency threshold: 50,2 Hz to 50,5 Hz inclusive; Droop: 2-12 %
requirements.conditions: For LFSM-O, in the synchronous area controlled by the relevant TSO, in coordination with TSOs of the same synchronous area.

requirements.requirement: The relevant TSO may choose to allow within its control area automatic disconnection and reconnection of power-generating modules of Type A at randomised frequencies, ideally uniformly distributed, above a frequency threshold, as determined by the relevant TSO where it is able to demonstrate to the relevant regulatory authority, and with the cooperation of power-generating facility owners, that this has a limited cross-border impact and maintains the same level of operational security in all system states.
requirements.value: Frequency threshold: 50,2 Hz to 50,5 Hz inclusive
requirements.conditions: For LFSM-O, in the synchronous area controlled by the relevant TSO, in coordination with TSOs of the same synchronous area.

requirements.requirement: In LFSM-U mode, the power-generating module shall be capable of providing a power increase up to its maximum capacity.
requirements.conditions: For LFSM-U, in the synchronous area controlled by the relevant TSO.

requirements.requirement: The power-generating module shall be capable of providing active power frequency response in accordance with the parameters specified by each relevant TSO within the ranges shown in Table 4.
requirements.value: Active power range related to maximum capacity: 1,5-10 %; Frequency response insensitivity: 10-30 mHz; Frequency response insensitivity: 0,02-0,06 %; Frequency response deadband: 0-500 mHz; Droop s1: 2-12 %
requirements.conditions: For frequency sensitive mode, in the synchronous area controlled by the relevant TSO.

requirements.requirement: The frequency response deadband of frequency deviation and droop must be able to be reselected repeatedly.
requirements.conditions: For frequency sensitive mode, in the synchronous area controlled by the relevant TSO.

requirements.requirement: In the event of a frequency step change, the power-generating module shall be capable of activating full active power frequency response, at or above the full line shown in Figure 6 in accordance with the parameters specified by each TSO (which shall aim at avoiding active power oscillations for the power-generating module) within the ranges given in Table 5.
requirements.conditions: For frequency sensitive mode, in the synchronous area controlled by the relevant TSO.

requirements.requirement: The frequency threshold specified by the TSO shall be between 49,8 Hz and 49,5 Hz inclusive, and the droop settings specified by the TSO shall be in the range 2-12 %.
requirements.value: Frequency threshold: 49,8 Hz to 49,5 Hz inclusive; Droop: 2-12 %
requirements.conditions: For LFSM-O, in the synchronous area controlled by the relevant TSO, in coordination with TSOs of the same synchronous area.

requirements.requirement: The power park module shall be capable of providing reactive power automatically by voltage control mode.
requirements.conditions: at the connection point, when operating at an active power output below maximum capacity (P<Pmax), if all units of that power park module which generate power are technically available

requirements.requirement: The relevant system operator in coordination with the relevant TSO shall specify the capability of a power park module to provide fast fault current at the connection point in case of symmetrical (3-phase) faults.
requirements.conditions: The power park module shall be capable of activating the supply of fast fault current either by ensuring the supply of the fast fault current at the connection point, or by measuring voltage deviations at the terminals of the individual units of the power park module and providing a fast fault current at the terminals of these units.

requirements.requirement: The schemes and settings of the different control devices of the power-generating module that are necessary for transmission system stability and for taking emergency action shall be coordinated and agreed between the relevant TSO, the relevant system operator and the power-generating facility owner.
requirements.conditions: N/A

requirements.requirement: The schemes and settings of the different control devices of the power-generating module shall be coordinated and agreed between the relevant TSO, the relevant system operator and the power-generating facility owner, and agreement shall be reached before any changes are made.
requirements.conditions: N/A

requirements.requirement: The relevant system operator shall specify the schemes and settings necessary to protect the network, taking into account the characteristics of the power-generating module. The protection schemes needed for the power-generating module and the network as well as the settings relevant to the power-generating module shall be coordinated and agreed between the relevant system operator and the power-generating facility owner. The protection schemes and settings for internal electrical faults must not jeopardise the performance of a power-generating module.
requirements.conditions: N/A

requirements.requirement: The power-generating facility owner shall organise its protection and control devices in accordance with the following priority ranking (from highest to lowest): network and power-generating module protection; synthetic inertia, if applicable; frequency control (active power adjustment); power restriction; and power gradient constraint.
requirements.conditions: N/A

requirements.requirement: Power-generating facilities shall be capable of exchanging information with the relevant system operator or the relevant TSO in real time or periodically with time stamping, as specified by the relevant system operator or the relevant TSO.
requirements.conditions: N/A

requirements.requirement: The relevant system operator, in coordination with the relevant TSO, shall specify the content of information exchanges including a precise list of data to be provided by the power-generating facility.
requirements.conditions: N/A
